extraFacts.fact: Ferryl was founded in Sweden in 1955.

faqs.q: What is Ferryl 101 Anticorrosive Wire Rope Oil?
faqs.a: Ferryl 101 is a penetrating anticorrosive oil for steel wire rope. Because it is liquid, it runs through the rope into the core and then sets to a semi-drying, flexible film that keeps moisture out. It is supplied in a 25 litre metal drum.

faqs.q: Which pack size and part number does Ferryl 101 wire rope oil come in?
faqs.a: Ferryl 101 comes in one pack: a 25 litre metal drum, part number IH-FRY-101-25L under SKU IH-FRY-101. Ferryl does not list a smaller pack for this oil. The companion [Ferryl 202 Standard grease](/p/ferryl-202-standard-anticorrosive-wire-rope-grease) has its own pack sizes.

faqs.q: How does Ferryl 101 oil differ from Ferryl 202 Standard wire rope grease?
faqs.a: Ferryl 101 is a liquid oil that runs into the core of the rope, while [Ferryl 202 Standard](/p/ferryl-202-standard-anticorrosive-wire-rope-grease) is a grease that clings to the outside and also penetrates. The two are fully compatible. Ferryl pairs them: 101 first where full penetration matters, then 202 Standard on top.

faqs.q: When should Ferryl 101 be chosen instead of grease alone on a wire rope?
faqs.a: Choose Ferryl 101 on new wires, or wherever full penetration into the core matters, with 202 Standard applied on top. It is also the choice in cold climates, where greases stiffen and become hard to apply. Ferryl says 101 can be used alone on vessels greasing wires in the cold.

faqs.q: How does Ferryl 101 oil behave in cold weather?
faqs.a: Ferryl states that 101 stays easy to work well below freezing, where a grease can become too hard to apply. Ferryl does not publish a temperature range or any figure for this oil, so we cannot quote one. Mixing 101 with 202 Standard softens the grease for cold-weather work.

faqs.q: Which surfaces and parts can Ferryl 101 anticorrosive oil protect?
faqs.a: Ferryl 101 is made for steel wire rope. Ferryl also lists it for winches, shackles, valves, bearings, lashings, screws and bolts. It leaves a semi-drying, flexible film with chemically active rust inhibitors and strong adhesion to the metal. Ferryl does not publish a list of compatible plastics or rubbers.

faqs.q: Does Ferryl 101 anticorrosive oil have a published standard or approval?
faqs.a: Ferryl publishes no standard or approval for Ferryl 101. The documents that exist are the Ferryl product information sheet and a safety data sheet, which we can supply on request. Colour and any viscosity or flash-point figures are not published, so we do not quote them.

faqs.q: Which products are used together with Ferryl 101 oil on wire rope?
faqs.a: Ferryl 101 is the oil partner to [Ferryl 202 Standard grease](/p/ferryl-202-standard-anticorrosive-wire-rope-grease), applied on top for external protection and lubrication. Both can be applied through the [Ferryl Wire Rope Lubricator](/p/ferryl-wire-rope-lubricator). For white paintwork, see [Ferryl 202 White](/p/ferryl-202-white-anticorrosive-wire-rope-grease).

faqs.q: How is Ferryl 101 applied to wire rope?
faqs.a: Apply Ferryl 101 by brush or glove, or through the Ferryl Wire Rope Lubricator. On a new wire, use it as a first coat so it reaches the core, then add 202 Standard grease on top. Mixing it with 202 Standard gives a softer consistency for cold-weather work or a particular application method.

faqs.q: Where is Ferryl 101 wire rope oil used on ships and offshore?
faqs.a: Ferryl lists Ferryl 101 for mooring wires and backsprings, crane and ramp wires, lifeboat falls, and hoists and derricks. It is also used on winches, shackles, valves, bearings, lashings, screws and bolts. It suits vessels greasing wires in cold climates.

faqs.q: Who makes Ferryl 101 and where is it made?
faqs.a: Ferryl 101 is made in Germany by Ferryl Deutschland GmbH and sold through Ferryl Sales Ltd, Isle of Man. Country of origin is Germany. Ferryl states in its brochure that it was founded in Sweden in 1955. Indus Hydraulics distributes Ferryl marine maintenance products in the Middle East.

faqs.q: What is Ferryl 103 Anticorrosive Drying Oil?
faqs.a: Ferryl 103 is a rust-preventive drying oil that sets to a tough, dry, waxy film. It is used to preserve spare parts, shafts, propellers, tools and tanks in storage. It comes off with a degreaser when the part is needed again. It is supplied in a 25 litre metal drum.

faqs.q: Which pack size and part number does Ferryl 103 drying oil come in?
faqs.a: Ferryl 103 comes in one pack: a 25 litre metal drum, part number IH-FRY-103-25L under SKU IH-FRY-103. No smaller pack is listed. Quote the part number when you ask for a price so the right drum is confirmed.

faqs.q: How does Ferryl 103 differ from Ferryl 101 wire rope oil?
faqs.a: [Ferryl 101](/p/ferryl-101-anticorrosive-wire-rope-oil) is a penetrating oil for wire rope that stays a semi-drying, flexible film. Ferryl 103 dries completely to a tough, dry, waxy coat that can be handled and stacked, so it suits parts in long storage rather than running wire.

faqs.q: When should Ferryl 103 be chosen to protect spare parts in storage?
faqs.a: Choose Ferryl 103 when metal parts must sit for months in a humid or salty store room, or on an open deck, and the thin transport oil they arrived with will not last. The coat can be built up thinner or thicker to suit how long the part is stored and where.

faqs.q: How long does Ferryl 103 protect stored parts?
faqs.a: Ferryl states that parts coated with 103 can be stored for several years without corrosion underneath. This is a maker statement, and Ferryl does not publish a test method or a guaranteed period. The film has a high melting point and good low-temperature behaviour, so it suits hot or freezing storage.

faqs.q: Which parts and surfaces can Ferryl 103 drying oil protect?
faqs.a: Ferryl lists 103 for spare and machine parts, spare propellers, shafts and axles, engines and machinery laid up, pipes, tanks and void spaces, chain cable, tools and moored-up wires. It is a rust-preventive oil for metal, with chemically active rust inhibitors and strong adhesion.

faqs.q: Does Ferryl 103 drying oil have a published standard or approval?
faqs.a: Ferryl publishes no standard or approval for Ferryl 103. The documents that exist are the Ferryl product information sheet and a safety data sheet, available on request. Colour, drying time and film thickness figures are not published, so we do not quote them.

faqs.q: Which Ferryl products go with Ferryl 103 for laid-up equipment?
faqs.a: Ferryl 103 protects stored parts, while [Ferryl 101](/p/ferryl-101-anticorrosive-wire-rope-oil) and [Ferryl 202 Standard](/p/ferryl-202-standard-anticorrosive-wire-rope-grease) protect wire rope that is working. For moored-up wires, 103 is listed by Ferryl. Browse the [wire rope and anticorrosive greases shelf](/c/wire-rope-anticorrosive-greases) for the full range.

faqs.q: How is Ferryl 103 drying oil applied and removed?
faqs.a: Apply Ferryl 103 by brush, spray, pouring or dipping. It dries to a dry, tough coat, so parts can be handled and stacked. Build the coat thinner or thicker to suit the storage time. When the part is needed, remove the film with a degreaser to return it to its original condition.

faqs.q: Where is Ferryl 103 anticorrosive drying oil used?
faqs.a: Ferryl 103 is used on spare propellers, shafts and axles, spare and machine parts, engines and machinery that are laid up, pipes, tanks and void spaces, chain cable, tools and moored-up wires. It suits ship stores, workshops and yards that keep spares for long periods.

faqs.q: Who makes Ferryl 103 and where is it made?
faqs.a: Ferryl 103 is made in Germany by Ferryl Deutschland GmbH and sold through Ferryl Sales Ltd, Isle of Man. Country of origin is Germany. Indus Hydraulics distributes Ferryl marine maintenance products in the Middle East.

faqs.a: We keep Ferryl 103 Anticorrosive Drying Oil in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send the product, pack size, quantity and delivery port or address, and we confirm the quote. Questions on use? [Contact us](/contact).

faqs.q: What is Ferryl 202 Aluminium Anticorrosive Grease (grease paint)?
faqs.a: Ferryl 202 Aluminium is an aluminium-pigmented grease paint. It goes on in a thin, paint-like coat but never dries hard, so it does not crack or peel where steel moves or carries a rolling load. It is aluminium grey and supplied in a 30 kg metal drum.

faqs.q: Which pack size and part number does Ferryl 202 Aluminium come in?
faqs.a: Ferryl 202 Aluminium comes in one pack: a 30 kg metal drum, part number IH-FRY-202A-30KG under SKU IH-FRY-202A. Ferryl does not list a smaller tin for this grade, so confirm the drum size suits the job before ordering.

faqs.q: How does Ferryl 202 Aluminium differ from a paint and from Ferryl 202 Standard?
faqs.a: Unlike an ordinary paint, Ferryl 202 Aluminium never dries hard, so it stays flexible under rolling loads. Unlike [Ferryl 202 Standard](/p/ferryl-202-standard-anticorrosive-wire-rope-grease), a dark wire rope grease, it carries aluminium for anti-seize on threads and an aluminium-grey colour that blends in on deck hardware.

faqs.q: When should Ferryl 202 Aluminium be chosen for lashings and turnbuckles?
faqs.a: Choose Ferryl 202 Aluminium for container lashings and turnbuckles. A thick grease is wiped off a thread as it turns, but a thin coat of 202 Aluminium stays on, protects the thread and keeps it easy to open and close. It also suits hatch-cover and crane rails.

faqs.q: What temperature range does Ferryl 202 Aluminium work in?
faqs.a: Ferryl rates 202 Aluminium for -30 °C to +70 °C on open deck, in salt water and in sunlight. Ferryl states that it does not drip in tropical heat and does not go brittle below freezing. Other performance figures, such as dropping point, are not published.

faqs.q: Which parts and surfaces can Ferryl 202 Aluminium grease paint be used on?
faqs.a: Ferryl lists 202 Aluminium for container lashings, turnbuckles, hatch-cover and crane rails and wheels, gear wheels, shackles, tank-cover screws, external hot spindles, and engine-room screws and bolts. The aluminium content gives anti-seize protection on threads, and it resists seawater.

faqs.q: Does Ferryl 202 Aluminium have a published standard or approval?
faqs.a: Ferryl publishes no standard or approval for Ferryl 202 Aluminium. The documents that exist are the Ferryl product information sheet and a safety data sheet, available on request. NLGI grade and dropping point are not published, so we do not quote them.

faqs.q: Which products go with Ferryl 202 Aluminium on deck hardware?
faqs.a: On deck, Ferryl 202 Aluminium pairs with [turnbuckles and rigging screws](/c/turnbuckles-rigging-screws) it protects. For wire rope, use [Ferryl 202 Standard](/p/ferryl-202-standard-anticorrosive-wire-rope-grease) or [Ferryl 202 White](/p/ferryl-202-white-anticorrosive-wire-rope-grease). All Ferryl greases are on the [wire rope and anticorrosive greases shelf](/c/wire-rope-anticorrosive-greases).

faqs.q: How is Ferryl 202 Aluminium grease paint applied?
faqs.a: Apply Ferryl 202 Aluminium by brush, glove or grease gun. A thin layer is enough. It stays on a thread as it turns, so it need not be reapplied each time a lashing or turnbuckle is opened. Ferryl does not publish a drying or recoat time because the film never dries hard.

faqs.q: Where is Ferryl 202 Aluminium used on ships and port equipment?
faqs.a: Ferryl 202 Aluminium is used on container lashings and turnbuckles, hatch-cover rails and wheels, gantry-crane rails, gear wheels, shackles, tank-cover screws, external hot spindles and engine-room fasteners. It suits open-deck steel that moves, flexes or carries a rolling load.

faqs.q: Who makes Ferryl 202 Aluminium and where is it made?
faqs.a: Ferryl 202 Aluminium is made in Germany by Ferryl Deutschland GmbH and sold through Ferryl Sales Ltd, Isle of Man. Country of origin is Germany. Indus Hydraulics distributes Ferryl marine maintenance products in the Middle East.

faqs.q: What is Ferryl 202 Standard Anticorrosive Wire Rope Grease?
faqs.a: Ferryl 202 Standard is a dark marine wire rope grease for wires that work on open deck, in salt spray and in climates from freezing to tropical. It protects the rope against rust and lubricates the strands. Packs are a 25 kg metal drum and a 900 g tin.

faqs.q: Which pack sizes and part numbers does Ferryl 202 Standard come in?
faqs.a: Ferryl 202 Standard comes in two packs: a 25 kg metal drum, part number IH-FRY-202S-25KG, and a 900 g tin, part number IH-FRY-202S-900G. The tin suits small jobs and the drum suits regular greasing of mooring and crane wires. SKU is IH-FRY-202S.

faqs.q: How does Ferryl 202 Standard differ from Ferryl 202 White and 202 Aluminium?
faqs.a: Ferryl 202 Standard is the dark grade. [Ferryl 202 White](/p/ferryl-202-white-anticorrosive-wire-rope-grease) does the same wire rope job in white, where dark grease would stain paintwork. [Ferryl 202 Aluminium](/p/ferryl-202-aluminium-anticorrosive-grease) is a paint-like grease for lashings and rails, not a wire rope grease.

faqs.q: When should Ferryl 202 Standard be used with Ferryl 101 oil on a wire rope?
faqs.a: On a new wire, or where full core penetration matters, Ferryl recommends a first coat of [Ferryl 101 oil](/p/ferryl-101-anticorrosive-wire-rope-oil) with 202 Standard on top. The two are fully compatible. They can also be mixed to soften the grease for cold-weather application.

faqs.q: How does Ferryl 202 Standard perform in heat and cold?
faqs.a: Ferryl states that 202 Standard has a high melting point so it does not drip in tropical heat, and that it stays workable below freezing. Ferryl publishes no dropping point, NLGI grade or temperature figures for it, so we cannot quote any. Rubberised binders keep it on the wire in a storm.

faqs.q: Which surfaces and equipment can Ferryl 202 Standard grease be used on?
faqs.a: Beyond steel wire rope, Ferryl lists 202 Standard for open gears, winches, shackles, lashings, hatch-cover wheels, tank-cover screws, valves, bearings, screws and bolts. Its semi-drying film keeps moisture out and stays flexible, and chemically active rust inhibitors protect thin spots in the film.

faqs.q: Does Ferryl 202 Standard have a published standard or approval?
faqs.a: Ferryl publishes no standard or approval for Ferryl 202 Standard. The documents that exist are the Ferryl product information sheet and a safety data sheet, available on request. For general grease selection, see our guide to [base oil, thickener and NLGI grade](/blog/grease-selection-base-oil-thickener-nlgi).

faqs.q: Which products work with Ferryl 202 Standard on a wire rope?
faqs.a: Ferryl 202 Standard works with [Ferryl 101 oil](/p/ferryl-101-anticorrosive-wire-rope-oil) as a first coat, and with the [Ferryl Wire Rope Lubricator](/p/ferryl-wire-rope-lubricator), which presses the grease into the core in one pass. Ferryl's published lubricator figures were measured with 202 Standard grease.

faqs.q: How is Ferryl 202 Standard applied, and how should the wire be prepared?
faqs.a: Apply Ferryl 202 Standard by brush or glove, or pump it through the Ferryl Wire Rope Lubricator. On a used or rusty wire, clean off old grease, rust and moisture first, or they are sealed in under the new coat. See also [how wire rope is constructed](/blog/wire-rope-construction-explained).

faqs.q: Where is Ferryl 202 Standard wire rope grease used?
faqs.a: Ferryl lists 202 Standard for mooring wires and backsprings, ship and offshore crane wires, ro-ro ramp wires, lifeboat falls, derricks and hoists. It is also used on open gears, winches, shackles, lashings, hatch-cover wheels, tank-cover screws, valves and bearings.

faqs.q: Who makes Ferryl 202 Standard and where is it made?
faqs.a: Ferryl 202 Standard is made in Germany by Ferryl Deutschland GmbH and sold through Ferryl Sales Ltd, Isle of Man. Country of origin is Germany. Indus Hydraulics distributes Ferryl marine maintenance products in the Middle East.

faqs.q: Is Ferryl 202 Standard Wire Rope Grease available in stock?
faqs.a: We keep Ferryl 202 Standard Anticorrosive Wire Rope Grease in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send the product, pack size, quantity and delivery port or address, and we confirm the quote. Drum (25 kg) or tin (900 g) must be stated.

faqs.q: What is Ferryl 202 White Anticorrosive Wire Rope Grease?
faqs.a: Ferryl 202 White is a white marine wire rope grease. It gives the same rust protection and lubrication as Ferryl 202 Standard, in a colour that does not stain white paintwork. It is supplied in a 30 kg metal drum.

faqs.q: Which pack size and part number does Ferryl 202 White come in?
faqs.a: Ferryl 202 White comes in one pack: a 30 kg metal drum, part number IH-FRY-202W-30KG under SKU IH-FRY-202W. No smaller pack is listed for this grade. The dark [Ferryl 202 Standard](/p/ferryl-202-standard-anticorrosive-wire-rope-grease) has a smaller pack.

faqs.q: How does Ferryl 202 White differ from Ferryl 202 Standard?
faqs.a: Ferryl 202 White does the same job as 202 Standard, but it is white, so it suits wires that run over white paintwork, vehicles or passengers. [Ferryl 202 Standard](/p/ferryl-202-standard-anticorrosive-wire-rope-grease) is dark and also comes in a small tin. Ferryl does not publish a performance difference between them.

faqs.q: When should Ferryl 202 White be chosen for lifeboat falls and ramp wires?
faqs.a: Choose Ferryl 202 White where appearance matters: lifeboat and tender falls on cruise ships and ferries, and ramp wires on car carriers and ro-ro vessels. It is also listed for steel mooring wires as an alternative to 202 Standard.

faqs.q: How does Ferryl 202 White hold up on a working wire?
faqs.a: Ferryl states that rubberised binders hold 202 White on the wire when tenders are lowered or a ramp is worked. A high melting point stops it dripping in tropical heat, and it remains workable below freezing. Ferryl says better adhesion means less frequent re-greasing, but publishes no figures.

faqs.q: Which wires and hardware can Ferryl 202 White grease be used on?
faqs.a: Ferryl lists 202 White for lifeboat falls and davit wires, ramp wires on PCC, PCTC and ro-ro vessels and steel mooring wires. It also suits winches, shackles, hatch-cover wheels, open gears, lashings, valves and bearings. It penetrates into the rope core and carries rust inhibitors.

faqs.q: Does Ferryl 202 White have a published standard or approval?
faqs.a: Ferryl publishes no standard or approval for Ferryl 202 White. The documents that exist are the Ferryl product information sheet and a safety data sheet, available on request. NLGI grade and dropping point are not published. Any lifeboat-fall requirement of your class society should be checked with us.

faqs.q: Which products go with Ferryl 202 White on a wire rope?
faqs.a: Ferryl 202 White can be applied through the [Ferryl Wire Rope Lubricator](/p/ferryl-wire-rope-lubricator). For the dark grade, see [Ferryl 202 Standard](/p/ferryl-202-standard-anticorrosive-wire-rope-grease). Ferryl pairs its grease with [101 oil](/p/ferryl-101-anticorrosive-wire-rope-oil) as a first coat on new wires; the oil is not described for 202 White specifically.

faqs.q: How is Ferryl 202 White applied to a wire rope?
faqs.a: Apply Ferryl 202 White by brush or glove, or through the Ferryl Wire Rope Lubricator. Clean used or rusty wires before you apply it, so old grease, rust and moisture are not sealed under the new coat. A semi-drying film then keeps seawater out and stays flexible as the rope bends.

faqs.q: Where is Ferryl 202 White wire rope grease used?
faqs.a: Ferryl 202 White is used on lifeboat falls and davit wires, ramp wires on PCC, PCTC and ro-ro vessels, and steel mooring wires. It also goes on winches, shackles, hatch-cover wheels, open gears, lashings, valves and bearings where white paintwork must stay clean.

faqs.q: Who makes Ferryl 202 White and where is it made?
faqs.a: Ferryl 202 White is made in Germany by Ferryl Deutschland GmbH and sold through Ferryl Sales Ltd, Isle of Man. Country of origin is Germany. Indus Hydraulics distributes Ferryl marine maintenance products in the Middle East.

faqs.a: We keep Ferryl 202 White Anticorrosive Wire Rope Grease in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send the product, pack size, quantity and delivery port or address, and we confirm the quote. To discuss an application, [contact us](/contact).
